# Содержимое файла userNotificationControl.ts {#sec-api-userNotificationControl .appendix}

``` python
import {Response, Request} from 'express'
import { createDb, getQuery, runQuery } from '../../db/queryDb';
import { NotificationType, UserRoleType } from '../../types/user';

type UserSendNotificationReqType = {
    clientId: number,
    type: NotificationType,
    payload: string
}

type UserGetNotificationsReqType = {
    clientId: number
}

export const userSendNotification = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {clientId, type, payload}: UserSendNotificationReqType = req.body
    
    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const clientExist = await getQuery<{
            id: number,
            username: string,
            hash_password: string,
            role: UserRoleType,
            ip_addr: string,
            short_code: string
        }>(
            db,
            `SELECT * FROM vpn_users WHERE id=?`,
            [clientId]
        )

        if (clientExist.length > 0) {
            const result = await runQuery(
                db,
                `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO notifications (client_id, type, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?);`,
                [clientId, type, payload]
            )

            db.close()

            if (result.changes === 0) {
                res.json({
                    success: false,
                    text: 'Уведомление уже отправлено'
                })
            } else {
                res.json({
                    success: true,
                    info: []
                })
            }
        } else {

            db.close()
            
            res.json({
                success: false,
                text: 'Администратора не существует'
            })
        }

    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        })
    }
}

export const userGetNotifications = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {clientId}: UserGetNotificationsReqType = req.body

    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const data = await getQuery<{
            clientId: number,
            id: number,
            type: NotificationType,
            payload: string,
            isRead: boolean
        }>(
            db,
            `SELECT client_id as clientId, id, type, payload, is_read as isRead FROM notifications WHERE client_id = ? AND is_read = 0`,
            [clientId]
        )

        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: true,
            info: data
        })

    } catch (e) {
        db.close()

        res.json({
            success: false,
            text: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        })
    }
}
```
